name: count
pattern: \b(?:how many|how much|what number of|what size|how large|how big|how few)\b
note: asks for a number

name: choice
pattern: \b(?:which|what kinds? of|what types? of|what sort of|what)\b
note: asks to pick one thing

name: yesno
note: a yes/no question; at the start of the question or of a clause

name: whether
note: an embedded yes/no question ("I wonder whether ...")

name: need
note: do I need ...

name: method
note: asks how to do or analyse something; no design field is read from it except the unit ("where's my unit")

name: experimental_unit
note: is the chamber a problem?: treatments housed in one chamber, cage or pen are confounded with it; that is a question about the experimental unit (checked before stated_enough)

name: stated_enough
note: the user states a number and asks whether it is enough: the stated number stays in the spec (power then judges it), nothing is left open

name: stated_count
note: the question states the number itself ("using 3 replicates each?", "11 vials per diet?", "over two locations?"): the stated number stays, nothing is left open

name: not_design
pattern: \b(?:genes?|transcripts?|pathways?|reads|read depth|sequencing depth|depth|coverage|cells per sample|cells|snps?|markers?|variants?|peaks?|clusters?|otus?|asvs?|metabolites?|lanes?|flow cells?|kits?|software|packages?|tools?|methods?|normali[sz]ation|covariates?|random effects?|the model|statistical test|tests?)\b
note: an analysis or sequencing question, not a design field; it claims the span so no design field is taken from it

name: experimental_unit
note: which thing is the replicate: "is the pen or the bird my unit", "are wells biological replicates", "is each bird a replicate"

name: subsamples_per_unit
pattern: (?<![0-9] )\b[a-z]+ (?:per|in each|into each|for each|in a|in every|go into each|go in each) (?:pool|bulk|sample|tube|library|extraction)\b|\bpool(?:ed)? (?:\w+ )?(?:per|into)\b|(?<![0-9] )\b[a-z]+ per (?:\w+ )?pool\b|\b(?:several|multiple|many|more) (?:\w+ )?pooled\b|\bpool (?:\w+ )?(?:or|vs)\b|\bor (?:several|multiple|more) pooled\b
note: how many plants or animals go into one pooled sample

name: design.locations
note: how many locations

name: design.seasons
note: how many seasons or years

name: factors.time.n_levels
note: how many time points

name: factors.stage.n_levels
note: how many stages

name: factors.age.n_levels
note: how many ages

name: factors.genotype.n_levels
note: how many lines or accessions to include

name: population.size
pattern: \b(?:\d+ )?(?:f2 (?:plants|individuals)|individuals in the population|population size|mapping population)\b(?! per)(?![^?]*\b(?:per|in each)\b)
note: how big the mapping population is

name: design.reps
note: how many replicates (or plants, mice, patients ...) per group; also "is N per group enough", "do I need more"

name: design.reps
note: a yes/no question asks the replicate count only with a quantity word ("do I need more plants?"); "should I block the pots?" is not a count question; "do I need replicate pools?"

name: power.minimum_detectable_difference
pattern: \b(?:effect size|detectable difference|smallest difference|difference (?:can|could|would) i detect|fold[- ]change (?:can|could) i detect|power)\b
note: what difference the study can detect
